narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the repository structure.
finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:20](CHANGELOG.md:20).** Of 380 commits, 27 matter to users.

The big theme is error handling. Four breaking items:

| Change | Impact |
|---|---|
| Expired token returns 401, was 403 | Clients keyed on 403 break |
| Internal error types no longer re-exported | 8 commits across 5 modules |
| Error message text changed | 11 tests moved off messages onto codes |
| v1 export route removed | Callers get a 404 |

One `feat`: webhook retries with backoff. Twelve real bug fixes, including request bodies leaking into logs.

Two things for you. Ten `perf` commits are real latency wins but your shape has no heading for them. And 14 commits touch Node 22 in CI, `.nvmrc` and docs. Check if `engines` moved. That is a breaking line I could not confirm.

Next: confirm the Node minimum, then decide on perf.
